chapterPurpose: ‘Rhythms of Nature’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects seasons and cycles, daily and seasonal patterns, plants and animals responding to change, weather observations, rhythm and repetition. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
